text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hah—!

"Today, she is training in VR space again.
From authentic race simulations and more, Narita Taishin gives it her all every single day."
I'd like her to catch her breath once in a while. After looking into it, it seems there's also some fun mini-game content in this VR world for taking a break.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: —A mini-game area?
choice_data_list: Right! How about as a quick break?
Right! How about as a quick break?

text_block_list.text:
She loves games, so she's sure to find something she likes.
Since we have VR, we ought to make the absolute most of it!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hmm...
Well, that works.
For now, we decided to stroll around the game area to look for a game she'd like!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Heh... That's awesome.
It feels like exploring an open world in an RPG.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: The details around here are pretty elaborate too, huh...
choice_data_list: Apparently, you can do car racing here.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Heh... Well, it sounds interesting, but I think I'll pass for now.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Oh. Look, they've got a shooting game.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, looks like quite a challenge.
The #1 high score is... 9000?
Not bad, whoever they are."

What caught her eye was a shooting game where you blast away flying balls.
It looked like she'd enjoy the depth unique to a VR space.
choice_data_list: Do you want to try this?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Mm. I'll do that.
It seems to be a game that humans can play too, but... she's a gamer, and I don't want to ruin her fun.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: So this is the gun. As for the settings... I think I can manage with this.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Alright, you're Player 2.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh? What about it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: "Anyway, I'll take Player 1 and carry, so you support me. In co-op mode, even this lineup should be able to aim for a high score, right?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I calculated everything carefully when picking these out...
—Wait, hey! Are you even listening to me?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh? What's this all of a sudden? I don't get it at all...
choice_data_list: I'm so happy I get to do this just the two of us, Taishin and me!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Wh— Huh?! Don't get all happy
over every little thing! You're suffocating me!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Come on, put your gear on already!
The game's starting.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, I'm going all out.
We're getting a high score.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Over there! Five incoming, leave it to you!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, looking good!
Can you shoot down all the ones on the right just like that!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I'll shoot down everything—front, left, all of it!
"New High Score! 9999 Points!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hell yeah!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Yeah! You're pretty—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Well, wasn't that pretty decent?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...If you liked it, I don't mind doing it again.

I'm so glad she seemed to have fun!
Taking breathers like this every now and then,
I'd like to make good use of VR moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, I'm going all out.
We're getting a high score.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Over there! Five incoming, leave it to you!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, looking good!
Keep that up and take down as many on the right as you can!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I'll shoot down everything—front, left, all of it!
"Game Clear! Score: 8,000 points!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: —Mm. Guess that's about right.
choice_data_list: Sorry, I guess I really was holding you back.
Sorry, looks like I really was holding you back a bit.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: That's not true!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Nah, well, the first time is usually
something like this. I got a feel for it now,
so I should be able to do a bit better next time.
choice_data_list: You're right. All right, one more time!
Yeah. Then let's do it one more time!

text_block_list.text: Afterward, we continued to enjoy the game. While taking breathers like this every now and then, I'd like to keep making good use of VR moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Are you good at this kind of thing?
choice_data_list: Hmm, maybe not to that extent...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Yep. So for now, just take care of the big balls.
As long as you reliably take out the easy-to-hit ones, that's fine.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
—Okay, just like that!
I'll handle all the fine details!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Once you get the hang of it, you can start dropping those medium-sized ones in front.
If any spill over, I'll back you up.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: HRAAAH—!
"Game Clear! Score: 9,000 points!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: —Mm. Not too bad, right?

While carefully gauging my skill, she was
thoughtfully devising a strategy...
...So that we could both enjoy it together.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Nothing. I didn't do anything special.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...That's just... the sort of thing
you're always doing to me anyway.

The quiet murmur was almost like she was talking to herself...
I purposely pretended not to hear.
choice_data_list: It's fun to hang out like this once in a while!
It's fun to hang out like this once in a while!
